propositions: Closing a ticket with verify.require_completion_verification_for_close=true reads HEAD independently during verify and sign phases, allowing an unrelated commit to land between them
When HEAD changes between verify and sign phases, the verify is discarded, sign is refused, but the ticket closes anyway without a completion attestation
The suggested recovery (re-close to certify) is a no-op because the ticket is already closed; only --force-close or manual manifest fabrication are available
The default (no --ref) code path still reads HEAD twice and is vulnerable to this race, while the --ref path from 80af pins the reference only for verify and sign, not for the full close unit
A non-force, non-fabrication recovery mechanism is needed to obtain a completion attestation for an already-closed-but-unsigned ticket
